import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

text = Path('/tmp/theme-chart.patch').read_text()
lines = text.splitlines()
i = lines.index('*** Begin Patch') + 1
while i < len(lines):
    action = lines[i]
    if action.startswith('*** Add File: '):
        path = action.split(': ', 1)[1]
        i += 1
        content = []
        while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('*** '):
            assert lines[i].startswith('+')
            content.append(lines[i][1:])
            i += 1
        Path(path).write_text('\\n'.join(content) + '\\n')
    elif action.startswith('*** Update File: '):
        path = action.split(': ', 1)[1]
        i += 1
        old, new = [], []
        while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith('*** '):
            if lines[i].startswith(('-', '+')):
                (old if lines[i].startswith('-') else new).append(lines[i][1:])
            i += 1
        source = Path(path).read_text()
        old_text = '\\n'.join(old)
        new_text = '\\n'.join(new)
        if old_text == '' and old_text not in source:
            source = new_text + '\\n'
        else:
            if old_text not in source:
                raise SystemExit(f'No match in {path}: {old_text[:120]"'!r}'"')
            source = source.replace(old_text, new_text, 1)
        Path(path).write_text(source)
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f'Unsupported patch line: {action}')
print('ok')
PY
python /tmp/apply-patch.py
